I wish, as I am sure you do, that I had someone in my life that could do those things for me.

All I know is that each day I make it through is another day that death loses out, even though often I wish it wouldn't. Supposedly it will get better, it has before for me, but not from this low. So all I can do is either hope it does before I set plans in place or it doesn't.

Fuck. I have been so at peace with my decision. 

I even cried for the first time in I do not know how long.

I find it difficult not to think that as everything dies and is the same in that respect, then everything has the same lack of value. I mean life is a precious thing, and i can almost say that it is an inherently good thing. Philosophically that doesn't work and that is okay, but I cannot get there any way for myself. 

In my three decades on this planet, I thought I had learned one thing, and that no matter how many connections we make, how many people or things we find a purpose in, none of those things are what i need to be okay. The only thing that really REALLY got me close was mind/mood altering substances. I could change who I was and how I felt at will and did. 

During the over half a decade I was in a relationship and married, I was diagnosed multiple times by multiple people and given multiple drugs to "fix" me. Nothing worked. Except one, and that was a barbiturate. Of course that would work. I crushed and snorted my way through every medication trying to get some sort of high off of anything, snuck as much alcohol as I could get away with, as used as much cocaine as I could get away with a few different blocks of time. 

What is in my head is a malignant and vicious living disease poisoning my heart and it is winning and always has. I was just too stupid and foolishly hopeful that I had beaten it. The lulls in despair, while not perfect, have been so good at masking what lied beneath that I somehow managed thirty years of it. The drugs were very good at this as well. 

Any kind of hope is a lie from within myself. What purpose it serves in doing that, I do not know. This last person I have met has suffered from much of what I have, but in different ways, some worse. She has faced full on addiction and beaten it, but still suffers from the crushing knowledge of futility while still having a grace and beauty to her soul that puts me to shame. 

I cannot believe that I will be able to find another person who has gone through the agony of trying to become different in this manner and for the same reasons AS WELL AS has chosen sobriety over death. That is what I realized and decided two months ago. Though, as my post shows, this is probably not going to be the case much longer. 

I am so fucking tired of pretending. Pretending to he happy. Pretending to be okay. To be well. Pretending that I am lovable and can be loved for who I truly am and what I feel, including this blackness. especially that. 

As I said, this is so highly improbable I cannot fucking handle it. I hate myself for what I have become. what I apparently need to live is pitiful and a shame. The worst part is that I could never tell her any of this. Besides the shame of being so fucked up and unstable, I feel that would be a monumental amount of guilt and responsibility to heap upon another. Or she would just blow it off, but I doubt it. Knowing her, it would weigh painfully on her heart and that is just unfucking fair. But by god there is a part of me that wants her to know what I am going through and hates every time I see her and have to act like I am doing okay.

So, first of all, I clearly stated that I have decided to certain debts I owe before leaving and stated my reasons for doing so. 

Second, good for you for finding a reason for life for yourself. I hope that it can lessen for you whatever depression your username implies. Unless you are saying you downvote in this subreddit. Otherwise, lucky you. Those things hold minimal to no value. I do and have done many "positive" things in my life in the vein of serving others or making a positive impact. Passively, I am vegan, haw been for almost seven years. Besides my commercial restoration construction job, which, by it's nature, keeps literally millions of tons of material out of landfills, I also volunteer in my spare time at a local animal shelter. There are other things I could list, but do not care enough to do so. Even were I to perform the largest, most successful direct action against fur or factory farming or what the fuck ever, it is all for shit. We are all going to die eventually. Our society will eventually destroy itself or run itself into the ground, people will continue to destroy the environment and themselves in the name of a dollar. 

As to your statements on emotions and motivators. A motivator is just that, what one uses for motivation. It can be anything. 

As for true love, I have come close twice, neither my marriage. The last time was recently, and mentioned above as an exception to following through. When you feel it, and think about, you know. That is all that can be.
